articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a larger effective context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex agentic coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in several technical fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Pro Tops Agentic Coding and Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind's latest Gemini 2.5 Pro model has taken top positions on SWE-Bench and several agentic research benchmarks, demonstrating an ability to autonomously navigate large codebases and synthesize findings across hundreds of academic papers. The model's improved tool-use capabilities and 2M-token context window make it particularly competitive for enterprise RAG and software engineering workflows.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Pilot Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure Robotics has started a limited production pilot of its Figure 03 humanoid robots at BMW's Spartanburg, SC plant, handling parts kitting and bin-picking tasks alongside human workers. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for task understanding and can adapt to novel part geometries without explicit reprogramming, marking a milestone in general-purpose humanoid deployment in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Warehouse Navigation and Manipulation
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot performing end-to-end warehouse logistics tasks including autonomous navigation, shelf stocking, and package sorting without teleoperation. The system uses a vision-only transformer pipeline derived from Tesla's FSD architecture, and Elon Musk indicated limited external sales could begin in early 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Persistent Memory and Sandboxed Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major update to its Claude platform enabling long-running agentic workflows with persistent memory across sessions, sandboxed code execution, and fine-grained permission controls for enterprise environments. The system allows Claude to autonomously manage multi-step projects over days, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints, targeting software development and research automation use cases.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm A16 Process Node for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A16 (2nm-class) process node featuring backside power delivery, with initial production allocated primarily to next-generation AI accelerator chips. The node delivers approximately 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction compared to N3E, which is expected to meaningfully improve inference cost-efficiency for large-scale AI data centers.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Reliable Logical Qubit Operations Below Error-Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained logical qubit operations with error rates below the fault-tolerance threshold on their latest trapped-ion system, executing circuits of over 100 logical gates with high fidelity. This represents a critical engineering milestone on the path to practical quantum computing, though commercially useful quantum advantage for real-world problems likely remains several years away.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Toyota Research Launch Open Sim-to-Real Transfer Framework for Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics and Toyota Research Institute jointly open-sourced a sim-to-real transfer framework for training dexterous robotic manipulation policies in simulation and deploying them to physical hardware with minimal fine-tuning. The framework, built on GPU-accelerated Isaac Sim environments, includes standardized benchmarks for grasping, tool use, and bimanual coordination, aiming to accelerate reproducible research in robotic dexterity.
